name: Hanover Park
description: Connect Claude with your data in Hanover Park. View and work with your investment data across funds, specific companies, and LPs. With your data easily reachable in Claude you can run analyses, generate investor reports, quarterly letters, slide decks and more in minutes. Surface insights for your partners that would previously take days to produce by hand.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hanover Park to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hanover Park to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.hanoverpark.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hanover Park MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hanover Park provides these MCP tools: get_capital_activity, get_fund_performance, get_investor, get_kpi_collection_status, get_kpi_values, get_portfolio_company, get_user_context, list_investors, list_portfolio_companies, get_management_fees, get_chart_of_accounts, and get_profit_and_loss.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hanover Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hanover Park in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Hanover Park MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hanover Park requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hanover Park is developed by Hanover Park. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
